name: Beached Sea Turtle
summary: Along Darkshore's shore, Beached Sea Turtle lies with a broken carriage on its shell. Greymist murlocs have gathered around the great carcass.

sections.title: A Beast in Harness
sections.body: You find a broken carriage strapped across a giant sea turtle's shell on Darkshore's misty shore. Many sea creatures have washed up along this coast, but this turtle was made to carry a load. Its handlers drove it onto the beach, and the carriage now lies abandoned in the tide.

sections.title: Scavengers of the Shallows
sections.body: Greymist murlocs soon swarm the turtle's remains. They have made a den among the rotting meat and scavenged timber. A marked container lies among their refuse and the broken carriage frame, left by the turtle's former masters.

sections.title: Naga Supply Lines
sections.body: After you bring the marked container to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine, its naga markings reveal the truth. The harness matches the supply carriages the naga use to carry weapons and war material from the ocean depths. The turtle's remains show that the naga are making incursions into northern Darkshore. The recovered container is sent to Darnassus for study.

faq.q: Why is there a carriage on the sea turtle's shell?
faq.answer: The naga harness giant sea turtles as pack animals and siege beasts. Their carriages carry supplies and weapons from the depths to Darkshore's coast.
A strangely marked box lies in the broken carriage. Its runes mark it as naga property, and scholars in Auberdine send it to Darnassus for scrutiny.

faq.q: Why are murlocs gathered around the turtle?
faq.answer: Greymist murlocs live along the coast and scavenge shipwrecks and beached carcasses. They have claimed the turtle's remains for food and a den.

faq.q: Who studies the beached creatures in Darkshore?
faq.answer: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine oversees the investigation into the beached sea creatures. She catalogs the relics and strange materials found among their remains.

faq.q: How does this turtle differ from other beached creatures along Darkshore?
faq.answer: Unlike many creatures that wash ashore sick or distressed, this turtle was harnessed to carry cargo. The naga drove it onto the beach.

faq.q: What happens to the marked box after Auberdine?
aliases: what does auberdine do with box
faq.answer: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde records the discovery in Auberdine and sends the naga box to Darnassus. Elven leaders there study the growing threat along their northern borders.

angles.text: As a night elf, you can see that naga supply beasts are washing up on Darkshore. Your ancestral enemies are reinforcing beachheads close to Darnassus.
As an Alliance member, you help Auberdine's sentinels learn from beached creatures. Their findings track murloc infestations and organized naga raiding parties.
